title: Message body of certain email is empty
creator: susanw12979
content:
I use a mail forwarding service, Fastmail, used to be Pobox. The entire body of the message is visible in fastmail, if I log in directly to fastmail. I have my fastmail account set to forward messages to a Gmail account, which is linked to my mobile Thunderbird app.

The message header appears in that Thunderbird Inbox, but the body is empty.

I have checked the message size limits in fastmail, gmail, and the Thunderbird app. They are all at least 10Mb.

The particular message is only 3.7 Mb total according to details on fastmail. Also not forwarding as attachment

Where is the message body?

Thank you for any suggestions.
